title: 최근 5년(2022–2026) 한국농공학회논문집 동향
headline: 최근 5년의 핵심 흐름은 ‘관개 · 가뭄 · 취약성’(60편)입니다. 가장 많이 등장한 키워드는 ‘agricultural reservoir · 농업용 저수지’이며, 서울대학교 연구진이 59편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 연평균 42편으로 직전 5년 연평균 66편보다 37% 적습니다 (진행 중인 2026년 제외).
비중이 가장 커진 주제: ‘관개 · 가뭄 · 취약성’(+7.2%p), ‘레이더 · 신경망 · 강우’(+3.0%p), ‘강우 · 빈도 · 강수’(+2.6%p).
새로 등장한 키워드: ‘groundwater · 지하수’, ‘water curtain cultivation · 수막재배’, ‘carbon neutrality · 탄소중립’, ‘water balance analysis · 물수지 분석’, ‘precision agriculture’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 현장 관측·조사, 딥러닝, 원격탐사, 회귀분석.
papers_note: 세 학회지 안에서 많이 인용된 대표 논문 20편

papers.title: 설계강우의 지속시간 및 시간분포에 따른 배수개선 농경지 침수 영향 분석
papers.title_en: Effects of Duration and Time Distribution of Probability Rainfall on Paddy Fields Inundation

summary.result: The results of inundation depth analysis showed similar trends to those of design flood calculations.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to analyze the effect of the duration and time distribution of probability rainfall on farmland inundation for the paddy fields in the drainage improvement project site.
summary.method: Inundation modeling was carried out for each study district using 48 hr and critical duration rainfalls.

papers.title: 기후변화 시나리오에 따른 소규모 저수지의 홍수 취약성 평가 - 경기도 내 저수지를 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: Assessment of Flood Vulnerability for Small Reservoir according to Climate Change Scenario - Reservoir in Gyeonggi-do -

summary.result: In the past period (2000s), the number of D and E grade reservoirs was 58, but it was found to increase to 107 in the 2055s period.
summary.background: Most of the reservoirs managed by the city and county are small and it is difficult to respond to climate change because the drainage area is small and the inflow increases rapidly when a heavy rain occurs.
summary.method: The flood vulnerability of reservoirs due to climate change was evaluated using the concept provided by the IPCC.

papers.title: 농업용 저수지의 가능최대홍수량 설계를 위한 하류부 피해 산정 방안 적용성 분석
papers.title_en: Analysis of the Applicability of Damage Assessment Methods for Downstream Impact Based on Probable Maximum Flood Design in Agricultural Reservoir

summary.result: Correlation analyses indicated limited relationships between reservoir specifications and damages, suggesting external factors like urbanization and soil conditions play significant roles.
summary.background: The Korean Rural Community Corporation (KRC) classifies I reservoirs as those with storage capacities of 300,000 m 3 or more, requiring safety inspections, detailed diagnostics, and seismic performance evaluations.
summary.method: Evaluation of fatalities revealed inconsistencies in reservoir classification based on statistical criteria.

papers.title: 실내모형시험을 통한 내재해형 온실 파이프 줄기초의 극한인발저항력 산정식 개발
papers.title_en: Development of a Theoretical Equation for Ultimate Uplift Capacity of Disaster-Resistant Greenhouse Continuous Pipe Foundation through Model Tests

summary.result: The uplift capacity calculated using estimation equation was compared with experimental values for verification, showed the highest correlation with the model test results, and produced the smallest error.
summary.background: Damage caused by meteorological disasters in domestic greenhouses is increasing.
summary.method: The ultimate uplift capacity was measured through laboratory model test.

papers.title: SSP 시나리오를 고려한 농업용 저수지의 이수측면 잠재영향평가
papers.title_en: Assessment of the Potential Impact of Climate Change on the Drought in Agricultural Reservoirs under SSP Scenarios

summary.result: The results of this study are expected to improve the credibility and accuracy formulation of vulnerability employing more scientific predictions.
summary.background: The assessment was based on the KRC (Korea Rural Community Corporation) 1 st vulnerability assessment methodology using RCP scenarios for 2021.
summary.method: As a main result, with lower future potential impacts observed in areas with higher precipitation along the southern coast.

papers.title: 여름철 UAV 기반 LiDAR, SfM을 이용한 하천 DTM 생성 기법 비교 분석
papers.title_en: Comparative Analysis of DTM Generation Method for Stream Area Using UAV-Based LiDAR and SfM

summary.result: The proposed method in this study can be utilized for constructing DTMs of stream and thus contribute to improving the accuracy of stream hydrodynamic simulations.
summary.background: Gaining an accurate 3D stream geometry has become feasible with Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), which is crucial for better understanding stream hydrodynamic processes.
summary.method: The objective of this study was to investigate series of filters to remove stream vegetation and propose the best method for generating Digital Terrain Models (DTMs) using UAV-based point clouds.

papers.title: 물수지 기반 농업용 저수지 내한능력 및 이수안전도 평가
papers.title_en: Evaluation of Water Supply Reliability in Agricultural Reservoirs Using Water Balance Analysis

summary.result: As a result, Yongmyeon Reservoir was found to be stable in terms of water supply reliability, whereas Seongho and Yongpung Reservoirs were found to be unstable using all methods.
summary.background: The design frequency of drought, the number of years areservoir needs to be able to withstand a drought phenomenon, foragricultural water resources in Korea is the 10-year drought.
summary.method: The previously designed frequency and water balance analysis were used to calculate and analyze reservoir storage capacity, water supply turnover, water supply amount, water supply potential, water utilization safety, and water supply reliability.

papers.title: 용수계통을 고려한 농업용수 수요량 산정
papers.title_en: Estimating Agricultural Water Demand Considering the Water Distribution System

summary.result: The findings of this study can serve as foundational data for addressing the discrepancies between agricultural water demand and supply.
summary.background: In this study, we propose a method for systematically estimating agricultural water demand using the EPA-SWMM model.
summary.method: The demand was compared and analyzed among three sources: the design criteria demand calculated using the Hydrological Operation Model for Water Resources System (HOMWRS), the demand calculated with the EPA-SWMM model using irrigation canal network, and the demand outlined in the National Water Management Basic Plan.

papers.title: K-HAS와 비율보정 계수를 이용한 농업용 저수지의 비상연계 용수공급 가능량 분석
papers.title_en: Analysis of the Emergency Water Supply Capacity in Agricultural Reservoirs Using K-HAS and Ratio Correction Factors

summary.result: The result of this study could suggest the standard for connecting water facilities as emergency water supply.
summary.background: The aim of this study is to analyze optimal water supply capacity of agricultural reservoir for emergency operation connecting reservoirs and dams.
summary.method: First, we simulated the water storage of agricultural reservoir playing the role emergency water supplier to other water facility such as dams and other reservoirs.

papers.title: 위성영상 토양수분 기반 FDII를 활용한 돌발가뭄의 메커니즘 분석
papers.title_en: Flash Drought Onset and Development Mechanisms Using Flash Drought Intensity Index (FDII) Based on Satellite-Based Soil Moisture

summary.result: The results of this study show that FDII is reliable flash drought analysis tool and can be applied to quantitatively analyze the characteristics of flash drought in South Korea.
summary.background: A flash drought is a rapid-onset drought that develops over a short period of time as weather and environmental factors change rapidly, unlike general droughts, due to meteorological abnormalities.
summary.method: FDII, which is calculated using soil moisture percentile, is expressed by multiplying two factors: the rate of intensification and the drought severity.

papers.title: 농지배수 수문설계 기준과 임계지속기간을 고려한 농업 소유역 침수분석
papers.title_en: Inundation Analysis of Agricultural Basin Considering Agricultural Drainage Hydrological Plan and Critical Rainfall Duration

summary.result: From the inundation analysis using the modified Huff method with different rainfall durations, 4 hours showed the largest peak discharge, and 11 hours showed the largest inundation depth.
summary.background: KDS (Korean Design Standard) for agricultural drainage is a planning standard that helps determine the appropriate capacity and type of drainage facilities.
summary.method: From the comparison analysis with the current method (Chicago method with a duration of 48 hours) and the modified Huff method applying critical rainfall duration, the current method showed less peak discharge and lower inundation depth compared to the modified Huff method.

papers.title: SSP 기후변화 시나리오에 따른 간월호 유역의 미래 유출특성 변화
papers.title_en: Future Runoff Characteristics of Ganwol Estuary Reservoir Watershed Based on SSP Scenarios

summary.result: The findings showed that as the impact of climate change intensified, the average annual runoff in the future period was higher in the order of SSP5, SSP3, SSP1, and SSP2, and the ratio of runoff in July decreased while the ratio of runoff in October increased.
summary.background: The estuary reservoir is a major source of agricultural water in Korea; for effective and sustainable water resource management of the estuary reservoir, it is crucial to comprehensively consider various water resource factors, including water supply, flood, and pollutant management, and analyze future runoff changes in consideration of environmental changes such as climate change.
summary.method: Climate data on future Shared Socioeconomic Pathway (SSP) scenarios were derived from two Global Climate Models (GCMs) of the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phase 6 (CMIP6).

papers.title: 수리·수문해석 모델을 활용한 농업용수 회귀수량 추정
papers.title_en: Estimating the Return Flow of Irrigation Water for Paddies Using Hydrology-Hydraulic Modeling

summary.result: As a result of estimating the irrigation return flow rate, it varied from approximately 44 to 56%.
summary.background: Irrigation return flow plays an important role in river flow forecasting, basin water supply planning, and determining irrigation water use.
summary.method: In this study, EPA-SWMM (Environmental Protection Agency-Storm Water Management Model) modeling was used to analyze the irrigation return flow and return flow rate of each intake work using irrigation canal network.

papers.title: 농업용 저수지의 이·치수 기능을 고려한 홍수기 제한수위 설정 기법 개발
papers.title_en: Determination of Flood-limited Water Levels of Agricultural Reservoirs Considering Irrigation and Flood Control

summary.result: The method was applied to Obong, Yedang, and Myogok reservoirs, and the results showed that the characteristics of each reservoir were well represented in the safety indices.
summary.background: In this study, we developed a method to determine the flood-limited water levels of agricultural reservoirs, considering both their irrigation and flood control functions.
summary.method: We expect that the method developed in this study will facilitate efficient reservoir operations.

papers.title: 위성영상을 활용한 북한 평안남도 간척지 실태조사
papers.title_en: A Satellite Imagery-Based Survey of Reclaimed Land in South Pyongan Province, North Korea

summary.result: The study found that the NDVI values of the reclamation areas are correlated with the land cover of the reclamation areas.
summary.background: The reclamation areas in South Pyongan Province were created in three stages, with the first stage completed in the late 1970s or early 1980s, the second stage in the late 1980s or early 1990s, and the third stage in the 2000s.
summary.method: The study also found that the NDVI values of the reclamation areas vary depending on the location.

papers.title: 유전자 알고리즘을 이용한 관수 저류조의 공간배치 최적화
papers.title_en: Optimization of Storage Tank Installation Locations for Pipeline Water Supply Using Genetic Algorithm

summary.result: The methodology presented in this study can be applied to determine the number and spatial arrangement of storage tanks for upland pipeline irrigation system design.
summary.background: Rice paddy has been actively converted into upland crop fields as more profitable upland crop cultivation are encouraged along with the decrease in rice consumption.
summary.method: Then genetic algorithm was adopted to evaluate the effects of spatial storage tank allocation on total pipeline cost.

papers.title: 기후변화 대응을 위한 로버스트 의사결정 기반 간월호의 시기별 관리수위 최적화
papers.title_en: Optimization of Seasonal Managed Water Levels of an Ganwol Estuary Reservoir Based on Robust Decision-Making for Climate Change Response

summary.result: Applying the optimal alternative showed improvements in terms of water supply.
summary.background: The frequency and magnitude of droughts and floods are increasing due to climate change, necessitating comprehensive water resource management of estuary reservoirs considering both water supply and flood control.
summary.method: Climate change data were selected from six Global Climate Models (GCMs) of Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phase 6 (CMIP6), designated as S1 to S6 in order of their precipitation levels, utilizing SSP (Shared Socioeconomic Pathway)1, 2, 3, and 5 scenarios.

papers.title: 베이지안 기법과 이상치 처리 기법을 적용한 동적콘관입시험 기반 건조 단위 중량 예측 모델 개발
papers.title_en: Development of the Prediction Model for Dry Unit Weight Based on Dynamic Cone Penetration Test Using Bayesian Method and Outlier Processing Techniques

summary.result: The results underscore the potential of this methodology in enhancing the accuracy and reliability of dry unit weight predictions in geotechnical engineering.
summary.background: The determination of soil dry unit weight is crucial for assessing the stability of diverse geotechnical structures.
summary.method: While empirical regression methods have been proposed to predict dry unit weight using data from various sounding techniques (e.g., CPT, SPT, and DCPT), these approaches may exhibit uncertainties when applied across different regions or soil types, thus compromising their reliability.

papers.title: HSPF-EFDC 연계모형을 활용한 간월호 염분 농도 분석 및 농업용수 적합성 평가
papers.title_en: Analysis of Ganwol Estuarine Reservoir Salinity Using HSPF-EFDC Coupled Model and Evaluation of its Suitability for Agricultural Water Use

summary.result: Overall, this study provides foundational information for effective salinity management in estuarine reservoirs, contributing to improved agricultural productivity and sustainable water resource utilization in reclaimed areas.
summary.background: The HSPF model was used to calculate river inflows from the upstream watershed, which subsequently served as boundary conditions for the EFDC model to simulate water levels and spatial salinity distributions.
summary.method: Model calibration and validation indicated generally satisfactory performance, although some discrepancies were observed during low-flow periods.

papers.title: MPC 모델을 이용한 팜맵의 정보 확장과 효율적인 정보 관리 방안
papers.title_en: Information Expansion and Efficient Information Management Method of Farmmap Using MPC Model

summary.result: Analysis of the difference based on the National Statistical Office's agricultural area survey shows that the combined area of paddy fields and fields differed by 7,252 ha in the case of a single-layer, but the difference in area accuracy was found to be greatly improved by about 588 ha in the multi-layer.
summary.background: Farmmap is constructed as a single-layer, so it has limitations in that farmland, infrastructure, and production facilities are mixed in same spatial information.
summary.method: In this study, multiple layers were proposed considering accurate calculation of farmland area and policy utilization using the MPC (Multi-layered Primitive Composite) model based on Farmmap.
